snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls Online - Return of the Worm Cult
snippet.description:
The dreaded Worm Cult has returned, and once more Tamriel’s adventurers will need to gather their allies, new and old, to stop the cult and their terrible plans for the isle of Solstice. Your new ESO adventure begins here! 

ESO’s 2025 Content Pass and 2025 Premium Edition are now available for purchase and include The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1, arriving June 2 on PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Pick up either edition before launch to acquire instant access to new dungeons and early rewards, including a new mount, pet, and emote pack.

Visit elderscrollsonline.com for more information and all the latest reveals and news. 

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TESOnline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Sexual Themes, Use of Alcohol, and Violence. Online interactions not rated by the ESRB.
